result.brief: 提出以SDF监督的向量神经元VAE构建物体几何感知潜表征，并用动作条件动力学预测物体级SE(3)增量，实现几何保持的多步3D世界模型预测。
result.reason: Object-centric 3D world model with SDF-supervised vector-neuron VAE latent geometry representation and action-conditioned SE(3) dynamics for manipulation; representation contribution plus world modeling.
